text: Delhi is India's capital and combines historic architecture, busy old-city lanes, green spaces, modern buildings and colonial-era structures.
Incredible India identifies three UNESCO World Heritage Sites in Delhi and highlights India Gate among the city's landmarks.
Delhi is served by Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) and New Delhi Railway Station (NDLS), as listed in the Incredible India travel information.
General India travel guidance: respect local dress codes and customs, particularly at religious sites and in rural areas.
General India travel guidance warns that scammers, pickpockets and ticket touts target visitors in tourist areas. Check ticket sellers and agents before paying.
General India travel advice recommends following local authority guidance, keeping belongings secure on public transport and in crowds, and using emergency number 112 when needed.

Delhi Metro Rail Corporation's network includes the Airport Metro Express between New Delhi, IGI Airport Terminal 3 and Dwarka Sector 21. Confirm current routes, service status and fares with DMRC before travelling.
